summary: We identified several active, strong-value used‑SUV candidates year 2020 or newer with under‑40 k miles in greater Philadelphia region. Top options include a 2022 Honda CR‑V EX (39 K miles, EX trim, dealer‑fees‑included) and a 2022 Subaru Forester Limited (21 K miles, limited trim). Additional promising vehicles include RAV4 and Forester Premium variants. No hybrids prioritized unless proven exceptional reliability; CR‑V hybrid not selected due to limited evidence. Fees generally included but verify final out‑the‑door cost.

trimComparisons.model: Honda CR‑V EX‑L vs EX vs Touring (2022)
trimComparisons.comparison: EX adds power tailgate and upgraded interior; EX‑L adds leather upholstery and power seats; Touring builds further with navigation and premium audio. EX offers solid value with key features like Apple CarPlay and blind‑spot monitor, without premium price of EX‑L or Touring.

trimComparisons.model: Subaru Forester Premium vs Limited vs Wilderness (2022)
trimComparisons.comparison: Premium is base trim with essentials; Limited adds leather, power seats, moonroof; Wilderness adds rugged styling and increased suspension. Limited balances comfort and price well, Wilderness adds value only for off‑road or styling preference.

trimComparisons.model: Toyota RAV4 XLE vs XSE vs XLE Premium (2022)
trimComparisons.comparison: XLE is mid‑level trim with useful convenience features; XLE Premium adds power lift‑gate and upgraded wheels; XSE (especially Hybrid or Plug‑In) adds sport‑oriented styling and performance. XLE Premium offers strong value for daily driving.

concerns: Fees not disclosed; verify out‑the‑door price
vehicles.notes: Well‑equipped EX‑L with leather, roof, CarPlay, low‑mileage; strong value if final cost reasonable.
